skill.summary: Skill operativa read-only para análisis de Jira Cloud con enfoque en contexto, bloqueadores y triage.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial public release of the Jira read-only operational skill for OpenClaw.

Included:
- search_issue_context
- summarize_issue
- analyze_blockers
- triage_backlog
- prepare_status_update

Notes:
- Read-only only
- Jira Cloud focused
- No write actions
- Designed to work with the @kansodata/kansodata-jira-plugin plugin
